# 維摩經疏

**ID:** T2770
**Volume:** T85
**Category:** 經集部類,敦煌寫本部類
**Original Category:** 古逸部
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T2770

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Wéimó jīng shū* (T2770) is a one-fascicle anonymous Vimalakīrti commentary preserved in the Dunhuang manuscript corpus and edited into Taishō volume 85. The Taishō header cross-references No. 475 (Kumārajīva's translation). Together with [KR6i0087](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0087), [KR6i0088](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0088), [KR6i0090](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0090), and others, it forms the Dunhuang Vimalakīrti commentary cluster (T2768–T2778) — provincial Tang exegetical literature preserved only on the Hexi corridor.

**Abstract**

The *shū* genre title (commentary, gloss) distinguishes this manuscript from the *yìjì* genre of [KR6i0087](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0087)–[KR6i0088](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0088) and the *chāo* genre of [KR6i0092](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0092) and [KR6i0093](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0093). The doctrinal content of T2770 reflects an early-to-mid Tang exegetical tradition with traces of Sānlùn (Three-Treatise) influence, suggesting an author trained in the [吉藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%90%89%E8%97%8F) Jízàng-school commentarial tradition. The manuscript witnesses are part of the Stein and Pelliot Dunhuang collections.
